title: Care Management Outreach to Referred Members
content:
Once a member is referred to Care Management, the care team starts outreach: the episode moves from referred to outreach, and a care team lead is assigned for outreach. A referral may also close before outreach begins, when the member is not eligible or the membership has ended.

## Policy

1. The first outreach attempt is made within the tier's first-outreach timeframe of the referral date, and outreach continues through the tier's outreach window, both counted in calendar days from the referral date.
2. After the tier's number of unsuccessful attempts, made on different days, the episode closes with the closure reason unable to reach.
3. A later self-referral opens a new episode.
4. Outreach attempts are recorded only while the episode is in outreach status. The status that counts is the one the system shows for that episode before the attempt is recorded.

Outreach also ends when the member declines, and the episode then closes.

## How attempts are counted

The unsuccessful attempts that count toward closing are the episode's recorded outreach attempts whose outcome is anything other than reached, within the period from the referral date through the referral date plus the tier's outreach window, counting at most one attempt per calendar day. A second or third unsuccessful attempt on the same calendar day adds nothing to the count; an attempt whose outcome is reached never counts.

## Worked count (hypothetical)

Hypothetical inputs: a tier requiring 3 unsuccessful attempts and a 45-day outreach window; referral date 1 March, so the window runs through 15 April.

| Attempt date | Outcome | Counted | Running count |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 March | No answer | Yes | 1 |
| 4 March | Voicemail left | No, same calendar day | 1 |
| 9 March | Wrong number | Yes | 2 |
| 12 March | Reached | No, outcome reached | 2 |
| 20 March | No answer | Yes | 3 |

On 20 March the count reaches 3 on three different days, the tier's figure, and the episode closes as unable to reach. An unsuccessful attempt dated 16 April would have fallen after the window and would not have been counted.

## Status check (hypothetical episodes)

| Episode status shown by the system | May an outreach attempt be recorded on it? |
|---|---|
| Outreach | Yes |
| Referred | No |
| Active | No |
| On hold | No |
| Closed | No |
